mechanism_supply_health.finding: The new SYSTEM selection followed a 3/3 MECHANISM window and keeps the one-in-three floor satisfied. This supports treating the rule as a minimum supply floor rather than a target ratio.

funnel_observability.finding: The completed SYSTEM Discovery is terminal and not queued, while the fresh SYSTEM Architecture successor is separately active. Claim ceiling and lifecycle are therefore observable rather than conflated.

preformal_gate_calibration.finding: No READY object exists. Existing prospective history still shows eligibility can precede outcome success, so no hidden second Formal gate is currently evidenced.

system_priority_exception_audit.latest_analyst_finding: Fresh SYSTEM Architecture successor is authorized because viable executable/informative MECHANISM count is zero; this is ordinary priority logic, not an exception.

no_coherent_target_audit.finding: NO_COHERENT_MECHANISM_TARGET remains unused. The current rolling floor is satisfied without needing the exception.

classification_completeness.policy_use: Canonical funnel policy rests on the complete Analyst-reviewed 15/15 material population. Conversion/disposition rates remain descriptive and are not used to define universal numeric thresholds.
